stem.text: Which structure best represents the species in the vapour at this temperature?

A.alt: Al2Cl6 ring structure: two Al atoms each bonded to two terminal Cl atoms and bridged by two Cl atoms, with the two bridging bonds drawn as arrows from the bridging Cl atoms to Al.

B.alt: Al2Cl6 ring structure: two Al atoms each bonded to two terminal Cl atoms and bridged by two Cl atoms, with the two bridging bonds drawn as arrows from Al to the bridging Cl atoms.

C.alt: Structure of a central Al atom bonded to three Cl atoms, drawn in a Y shape: two Cl atoms above left and right, one Cl directly below.

D.alt: Al with superscript 3+ followed by Cl with superscript minus in brackets, with subscript 3.
